gl.renderer: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M5, Unspecified Version)

notes: Grain is disabled in every configuration. ffmpeg's noise filter seeds from the wall clock, so two ffmpeg runs of the same grain config do not agree with each other and there is no ground truth to measure.

ffmpeg times include the HTTP round trip and the server's own decode, and the server caches by config, so a repeated config is much faster than a fresh one. The median below is over first-time renders in this sweep only.
The GPU warm number is a re-render with the source texture and every look up table already resident, which is the case while a slider moves.
